sloka: निरस्यमानो रामस्तु दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा ।नाशक्नोदभिसन्धातुं सायकान् रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.१०३.३५ ।।
transliteration: nirasyamāno rāmastu daśagrīveṇa rakṣasā ।nāśaknodabhisandhātuṁ sāyakān raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.103.35 ।।

translations.english: The Sun seemed without radiance like the colour of weapon (grey), in the form of Kabhanda (headless trunk), combined with Dhumakethu.
